articles.title: Jay Shah gets second term as ICC Chairman without a contest
articles.description: Jay Shah has been re-appointed unopposed as the Chairman of the International Cricket Council for a second term. This decision was made during the ICC Board meetings held in Bali, Indonesia. His new term will coincide with cricket returning to the Olympic Games in Los Angeles in 2028. Additionally, the ICC aims to expand the sport's global fan base and create opportunities for emerging cricket nations.

articles.title: Hopkins’ late stunner sends Kansas City past Gotham and into NWSL final
articles.description: Hopkins’ 89th-minute volley seals dramatic 2-1 upset Bethune scores stunning free kick against top seeds Current to face Washington Spirit for first NWSL title After a week dominated by a headline-grabbing stadium scheduling imbroglio, Gotham FC and the Kansas City Current finally got down to the vital business of their NWSL semi-final on Sunday afternoon, a frigid encounter at an unlikely venue on New York City’s Randall’s Island with a place in next Saturday’s championship match at stake. Haley Hopkins delivered the knockout blow at the death, hitting an 89th-minute volley off the crossbar and in to seal a 2-1 upset that left Gotham FC’s title defense in tatters. Paired with Croix Bethune’s first-half free-kick stunner, the late winner sent fourth-seeded Kansas City past the defending champions into a championship showdown in six days against the Washington Spirit. articles.description: Logitech is giving its 7,000 employees an extra paid day off to play GTA 6 or any other video game under its new Logi Game Day initiative. The perk covers full-time staff and interns, and can be used anytime until November 2027. The company says gaming boosts work performance, as GTA 6 arrives on November 19 amid estimates of a $1 billion US productivity hit.

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo expanded his hotel empire with a €60 million Paris project featuring 210 rooms and a 2027 opening
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo expanded his Pestana CR7 hotel empire with a planned €60 million project in Paris, which was expected to open in 2027. The 210-room property was set to become the partnership's sixth hotel. With five existing properties across Funchal, Lisbon, Madrid, New York and Marrakech, the expansion highlighted how Ronaldo had built an international hospitality business beyond his football career.

articles.title: MrBeast turns his YouTube channel into a real-life Hunger Games arena with magnetic weapons and a $250,000 prize
articles.description: MrBeast has launched Beast Hunger Games, a real-life battle royale featuring 12 teams competing for a $250,000 prize. The challenge uses magnetic foam weapons and sensor suits to determine eliminations. Familiar faces, including former Beast Games winner Jeff Allen, have returned. MrBeast also participates alongside his wife, Thea Booysen. The YouTuber's latest project could become an annual competition following its long-awaited debut.

articles.description: Keelon Russell threw for 217 yards and three touchdowns, and No. 7 Alabama beat Vanderbilt 21-6 on Saturday in an ugly game that did little to help the Crimson Tide's stock for the College Football Playoff.

articles.title: "Everybody wants to do what it takes to win": Christian Yelich revealed why he accepted being benched during the Brewers' historic World Series run
articles.description: Christian Yelich opened up about accepting a reduced role during the Milwaukee Brewers' 2026 World Series campaign. The former MVP explained that he never expected manager Pat Murphy to justify every lineup decision. Instead, he prioritised the team's championship ambitions over personal recognition. Yelich also contributed in 12 postseason appearances, batting .268 with five RBIs and four stolen bases, while embracing his responsibilities as a team leader.

articles.title: In 2019, Roger Federer invested $50 million in On for a 3% stake; two years later, it was reportedly worth $300 million
articles.description: Roger Federer’s reported $50 million investment in Swiss sportswear brand On in 2019 became one of his biggest financial successes. He acquired an estimated 3% stake, which Forbes later valued at more than $300 million after the company went public in 2021. The investment followed his split from Nike and showed how Federer turned his sporting influence into a valuable business opportunity beyond professional tennis.
